summary: Backend-only regression for the 50 Social starter-activities addition. Verified auth flow, fresh-user seeding counts (408 total with exact per-category distribution), Social title uniqueness (50/50), Social duration coverage (5,10,15,20,30,45,60 - all 4 required buckets present), seeding idempotency on re-login, no 200-row truncation on GET /api/activities, custom activity creation persistence, and favorite toggle. All 11 pytest cases passed against the public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 833 lines - approaching the 700-line split threshold; consider splitting starter data (STARTER_ACTIVITIES) into a separate module (e.g. starter_activities.py) since it's ~400 lines of pure data and dominates the file.
seed_user() favorites logic hard-codes {'Reading','Wellness'} as default favorites; may want to make this configurable or reconsider auto-favoriting on seed.
GET /api/activities uses .to_list(2000) - fine for now but hard limit will bite when users add many customs; consider pagination.
test_credentials: Existing: littlewhile.test@example.com / LittleWhile123! (used for existing-user non-reseed check). Fresh accounts generated per run with pattern test-social-<ts>-<rand>@example.com / TestPass123!.
seed_data_creation: Each run registers one fresh account (408 seeded activities) and creates one custom activity (TEST_custom_activity) under that account. No cleanup performed; fresh emails per run mean no collisions.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_social_seed.py is the authoritative regression for starter-activity content. If STARTER_ACTIVITIES changes, update EXPECTED_COUNTS at top of file. Persistent-account test skips gracefully if login fails. All tests hit the public URL and use HTTP-only cookie auth as configured.
rca of the issue: N/A - no issues found. Data content addition validated as spec'd: 408 total activities, Social=50 unique, durations {5,10,15,20,30,45,60} covered.
